18	This util is designed to fetch tests to run on a PR so that only the tests impacted by the modifications are run, and
19	when too many models are being impacted, only run the tests of a subset of core models. It works like this.

21	Stage 1: Identify the modified files. For jobs that run on the main branch, it's just the diff with the last commit.
